(CA-36) and a per-action Dry run (CA-37), set in the editor (CMP-233, CMP-145; §6 step 1) and restated in SCR-085; both are IR fields, so changing either is a new version that must pass the gate again (SC-9, CA-32); whether a change that only adds asking first or a dry run may skip the gate is E35-T06's (24 §11.7).
